diagnosis: Prospective seat addition under a startup plan in US-West. Knowledge base article kb-0011 confirms pro-rata billing for seat additions from day of addition, so a straightforward answer can be provided using that article.
reply: Seat additions are billed pro rata from the day they are added, so you would only be charged for the remaining days of the billing cycle for those 4 seats, not the full month. Seat removals only take effect at renewal and are not credited mid-cycle (see kb-0011 for details).
